identity_integrity.question: Catalog number, performer, date, series, exact source title, source tags and source CTA remain correctly attached to the work; editorial interpretation does not overwrite source or canonical data.

specificity.question: The core judgment names source-specific people, relationships, settings or adult topics and cannot be reused by only changing the performer or catalog number.

originality.question: The angle, opening, section logic and conclusion differ from recent reviews instead of defaulting to generic progression, rhythm or contrast arcs.

narrative_coherence.question: Creative reconstruction forms a coherent, engaging reading rather than disconnected invented details.

analysis_depth.question: The review explains how its source-grounded adult topics combine, which are central versus secondary, and why that combination matters.

search_value.question: Catalog number, performer and CC18 adult-topic vocabulary appear naturally in the title, topic summary and prose, answer selection questions and avoid keyword stuffing.

decision_value.question: Readers can quickly identify the work's people or identity, body type, costume, relationship, setting, acts or positions, presentation, trade-offs, suitable audience and unsuitable audience.

low_repetition.question: Sections answer different questions and do not recycle the same claim or rely on 被引導到主動、節奏逐漸升高、反差魅力 as universal filler.
